rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-1 onboarding on breast_ct (128-view sparse, mu up to ~0.05): plain TV-iterative reconstruction (solver_tv_search), seeded from the Mayo/manhart baseline (tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iter=200, tv_lr=0.01, gd, fbp init). val_n=200 (full breast val, seed-20260703 split). Feasibility: does plain TV run on breast and clear the FBP baseline, or does the documented FBP+smooth-init hr=0 ceiling hold? Documented risk (docs/findings.md): FBP+smooth init can make TV learn ~zero gradient -> hr=0.
